texts.title: The Wound
texts.body: It will heal, the physicians say, and it will always show. You have looked at it in the glass. A person is not quite the same afterwards: slower on one side, and aware for the first time of having a body that can be broken.

choices.carry_on_as_before: Carry on as before, and be seen to.

texts.title: The Physicians' Verdict
texts.body: They are careful how they put it. You are not dying, they say; you are simply not going to get better. The strength that was there last year is not coming back. There is time. It would be wise to use it.

choices.spend_the_time_with_the_family: Spend the time with the family.

texts.title: An Old Friend
texts.body: {friend.name} of {friend.house} is in the city and has sent word, the way {friend.he} always does: no title, no business, a time and a place. You have known each other longer than either of you has held any office. There are not many people you can say that of.

texts.title: A Friend Is Buried
texts.body: The news came by an ordinary messenger on an ordinary day. You had been friends for longer than you have been most of the things you are. The house goes on around you as if nothing had happened.

texts.title: The Enemy Is Dead
texts.body: For years there was someone whose first thought on hearing your name was how to do you harm. That person is dead, of nothing you did. A part of how you have arranged a life was arranged against them.

texts.title: A Death in the House
texts.body: {dead.name} is dead, and the house must bury its own. What was said at the graveside is written below, and in the book. How it is done is yours to decide, and everyone who was there will remember it.

choices.a_funeral_the_city_sees: A funeral the city will see.

texts.title: The Elder at the Table
texts.body: {elder.Rel}, {elder.first}, laid the house down and has not quite laid it down. At dinner {elder.he} has an opinion on the matter before you, and the household has turned to hear it before you have spoken. {elder.first} ran this house for a long time.

texts.title: The Elder Makes Peace
texts.body: Two of the house had not spoken civilly in a year, {kin.name} one of them. The old head, who gave the house up and kept the chair by the window, had them both in one afternoon and shut the door. Nobody has said what passed. They came down to dinner together.

choices.thank_the_elder: Thank the old head for it.
choices.ask_what_was_said: Ask what was said in that room.
choices.say_it_was_yours_to_settle: Say that it was yours to settle.
